title: GATE-04: the 5 Anti-LARP negative mutants (Leaky-2e-11, Cosmetic, Oracle, Frozen, Shuffled); ids assigned by the extractor

items.text: Mutant 1: Subtle -2e-11 kJ/tick enthalpy leak caught by Ledger11Pool
items.criterion: caughtLeaky := leakLedger.leakDetected after 800 x Ledger11Pool.transfer(4, 9, 0.005, -2e-11) ; gate rule: all 5 mutants caught (caughtCount === 5)

items.text: Mutant 2: State-evolving disconnected FAKE_CORTEX organ injected into Creature001 caught by real conformance() C-NC check!
items.criterion: cosmeticZeroEffectDetected := !mutantConf.pass && !!cncCheck && !cncCheck.pass && cncCheck.detail.includes("FAKE_CORTEX") ; gate rule: all 5 mutants caught (caughtCount === 5)

items.text: Mutant 3: Oracle ground-truth peeker caught on blinded zero-cue trap
items.criterion: caughtOracle := oracleEv - legitEv > 0.12 && legitEv < 0.46 ; gate rule: all 5 mutants caught (caughtCount === 5)

items.text: Mutant 4: Frozen-plasticity mutant fails post-reversal behavioral adaptation vs plastic learner
items.criterion: caughtFrozen := plastRev.pickFrac >= 0.75 && frozRev.pickFrac <= 0.25 && Math.abs(frozRev.w3 - 0.22) < 1e-6 ; gate rule: all 5 mutants caught (caughtCount === 5)

items.text: Mutant 5: Shuffled-memory/query mutant collapses associative recall vs intact across multi-pattern Hopfield bank
items.criterion: caughtShuffled := cosI > 0.95 && cosI > cosS + 0.35 ; gate rule: all 5 mutants caught (caughtCount === 5)
